headline: Steady year-over-year growth cools on a sequential basis
summary_short: Visa's Q2 FY2026 revenue rose to $11.63B (+14.4% y/y, +3.6% q/q) and diluted EPS reached $2.97 (+10.4% y/y), though EPS and net income ($5.63B) both slipped q/q (-5.4% and -6.5% respectively).
summary_long: Revenue of $11.63B rose 14.4% y/y and 3.6% q/q. Operating income of $7.13B rose 15.4% y/y but fell 1.4% q/q; operating margin eased to 61.3% from 64.4% q/q. Gross profit of $8.90B rose 8.5% y/y, down 2.6% q/q. EBIT of $7.03B and EBITDA of $7.39B each rose about 10% y/y, down roughly 4% q/q. Net income of $5.63B rose 6.8% y/y but fell 6.5% q/q. Diluted EPS of $2.97 rose 10.4% y/y, down 5.4% q/q.
